note.en: Capabilities of engines and models as data. Written by the Models strand from vendor documentation; not verified on the device. Entries marked unknown stay adjustable and are flagged so they can be tried (probe).
note.de: Fähigkeiten von Engines und Modellen als Daten. Vom Strang Modelle aus Anbieterdokus zusammengetragen, nicht auf dem Gerät geprüft. Einträge mit „unknown“ bleiben regelbar und werden als ungeklärt markiert, damit man sie ausprobieren kann (Sonde).

states.unknown: adjustable and sent, flagged as unverified
states.off: greyed out, not sent (the engine ignores it or does not have it)
states.error: greyed out, not sent (the request is rejected with an error)
states.fixed: greyed out, shows the fixed value of the model
states.config: not part of the request; set through the engine's server configuration (needs server.py, see KONZEPT 19.4); greyed out until then

status.drittquelle: third-party source, vendor wording not seen
status.code: taken from our own code (lib/providers.js, chat.html), simulated tests only

rules.resolve: 1. engineFor(provider, baseUrl): the first endpointRules entry whose hostContains is part of baseUrl wins, otherwise engines[provider.id], otherwise engines.openai. 2. modelRule: the first models entry whose match (case-insensitive regex on the model id without a leading 'models/') fits and whose engine equals the resolved engine or the engine named in engines[engine].modelRulesFrom. 3. The cell of a parameter is engines[engine].params[key] merged with models[i].params[key] (model overrides).

note.en: One definition for every engine so dashboards compare. Open: does the engine's output count include the thinking tokens (stats.outputIncludesReasoning).
note.de: Eine Definition für alle Engines, damit Dashboards vergleichbar sind. Offen: enthält die Ausgabezahl der Engine die Denk-Token (stats.outputIncludesReasoning).

fields.outputTokens: all generated tokens as the engine counts them
fields.reasoningTokens: thinking tokens, 0 if the engine does not report them
fields.visibleTokens: answer tokens the user sees; outputTokens minus reasoningTokens when the engine includes them, otherwise outputTokens
fields.source: 'provider' when the engine reported usage, 'estimate' when counted from stream chunks (existing flag: approx)
fields.tokensPerSecAll: visibleTokens + reasoningTokens per second of generation
